title: '3D-QSAR-based, pharmacophore modelling, virtual screening, and molecular docking studies for identification of hypoxia-inducible factor-1 inhibitor with potential bioactivity.
authors: Yadav, Piyush Kumar; Singh, Suchitra; Singh, Ajay Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过3D-QSAR、虚拟筛选和分子对接研究HIF-1α小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合机制，仅方法部分可迁移。
abstract: Iron overload is a primary cause of vital organ failure in patients with blood transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia, and the hypoxia-inducible factor-1 alpha (HIF-1alpha) plays an important role in iron homeostasis pathway. HIF-1alpha modulation as a potential therapeutic target approach for iron chelation in hepatocyte cells. In this study, we used a 3D quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) analysis to predict the inhibitory activity of HIF-1alpha inhibitors for iron chelation in liver cells. These feature descriptors were used to build a 3D-QSAR model, which was validated using Cost analysis and Fischer's randomization test. The model was used to virtually search the chemical compound libraries for potential inhibitor candidates with least inhibitory activity. The High-throughput Docking (Libdock) approach was used to dock large repositories of chemical molecules. Following Libdock score screening, the protein-ligand poses were docked using docking optimization (Cdocker) method. Binding energy were calculated for the protein-ligand poses of lowest -Cdocker Energy and -Cdocker Interaction. Further, side chain hopping method was used to generate lead novel ligand from best hit pose of ligand. Molecular dynamics simulation study to evaluate the lead novel ligand. Our study demonstrates the utility of 3D-QSAR pharmacophore screening in predicting the inhibitory activity for target. Inhibition strategy for iron chelation provides an alternative routes for reducing the iron content.
abstract_zh: 铁过载是输血依赖性β-地中海贫血患者重要器官衰竭的主要原因，而缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1alpha）在铁稳态通路中发挥重要作用。HIF-1alpha调节作为肝细胞铁螯合的潜在治疗靶点方法。在本研究中，我们采用三维定量构效关系（QSAR）分析来预测HIF-1alpha抑制剂对肝细胞铁螯合的抑制活性。这些特征描述符用于构建3D-QSAR模型，并通过Cost分析和Fischer随机化检验进行验证。该模型用于虚拟筛选化合物库，以寻找具有最低抑制活性的潜在抑制剂候选物。采用高通量对接（Libdock）方法对接大型化学分子库。经过Libdock评分筛选后，使用对接优化（Cdocker）方法对蛋白质-配体构象进行对接。计算了具有最低-Cdocker能量和-Cdocker相互作用的蛋白质-配体构象的结合能。进一步，采用侧链跳跃方法从最佳命中配体构象中生成先导新型配体。进行分子动力学模拟研究以评估先导新型配体。我们的研究展示了3D-QSAR药效团筛选在预测靶标抑制活性方面的实用性。铁螯合的抑制策略为降低铁含量提供了替代途径。
